title: Where to watch the Perseid meteor shower around Cochrane this week
desc: One of the best meteor showers of the year peaks this week, and Cochranites won't have to travel far to try to catch the show. The annual Perseid meteor shower peaks overnight Wednesday, Aug. 12 into the early morning hours of Thursday, Aug. 13. This year could be an especially good one for stargazers. The peak coincides with a new moon, meaning there will be virtually no moonlight washing out the night sky. Under ideal dark-sky conditions, observers could potentially spot dozens of meteors per hour. So, where should you go around Cochrane? The biggest thing is getting away from streetlights and Calgary's glow.
